name: Tablescope Analytical Method Reference Catalog
description: Governed catalog of statistical/ML methods. The LLM explains results; Tablescope selects and executes the method.

shared_policies.name: Missing-data handling
shared_policies.description: Missingness is an explicit analytical decision, never a silent row drop.

report: number and percentage of affected observations
whether imputation occurred before or within validation
whether conclusions materially changed under an alternate treatment

shared_policies.name: Outlier and influence handling
shared_policies.description: Fit with and without influential observations and compare.

shared_policies.name: Multiple-testing control
shared_policies.description: Correct for multiplicity when many tests are performed.

shared_policies.name: Significance reporting
shared_policies.description: A p-value alone is never the primary explanation.

shared_policies.name: Causal-language control
shared_policies.description: Causal wording is gated behind verified identification assumptions.

shared_policies.name: Minimum sample size
shared_policies.description: Return insufficient_data rather than forcing a method on too few rows.
